info.title: API.SH: HouseSigma
info.description: The HouseSigma API from API.SH: public HouseSigma data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every city and region HouseSigma covers in a province, with its municipality id (for search and market), region and map link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/housesigma-cities

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Province (default ON).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One HouseSigma listing: status, price, MLS number, address, cross street, community, city, coordinates, property type, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, size, lot, tax, maintenance fee, brokerage, all photos, open houses and virtual tours, key facts, every property detail section (property, building, inside, utilities, parking, land), rooms with sizes and levels, the listing history at this address, price changes, HouseSigma's estimate and rent estimate, community market stats, schools and FAQ, plus `raw`. HouseSigma's own agents shown on the listing (`housesigma_agent`, `assigned_agent`). Sold prices and some dates need a HouseSigma account and come back as the site shows them logged out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/housesigma-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (16 characters) or a housesigma.com listing link (or use latest).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: the newest listing of a search (city default toronto; any search parameter may be added) instead of id.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With latest: the city to take the newest listing from.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Market trends for a Canadian city (optionally one community and property type): the current month's median sold price and its 1-month, 1-year, 5-year and 10-year change, sales, new and active listings and days on market, plus monthly history (median sold price, sales, new and active listings, days on market, sold-to-new-listings ratio, median rent, leases, new rentals) for up to 20 years, and the city's communities and property types with ids.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/housesigma-market

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name, "City, BC" or a housesigma.com city link (or municipality_id).

parameters.name: municipality_id
parameters.description: HouseSigma municipality id instead of city.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Province of the city (default ON).

parameters.name: house_type
parameters.description: all (default) or one property type.

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: A community id from this route's communities list (default all).

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Years of monthly history (1-20, default 5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: HouseSigma homes for sale and for lease
get.description:
Active Canadian listings for sale or for lease on HouseSigma in a city or a map area, with the site's filters (property type, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, garage, square feet, lot frontage, basement, open houses, days listed, maintenance fee, keywords, resale or assignment) and sorts (newest, price up or down). Each listing has id, link, MLS number, status, price, address, community, city, province, coordinates, property type and style, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, size range, lot, date added, HouseSigma's estimate and scores, open houses, brokerage and a photo, plus `raw`. HouseSigma counts at most 4,000 results per search (`total_capped`); narrow the filters for more. Sold and leased prices need a HouseSigma account and come back as the site shows them logged out. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/housesigma-search

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City: a name (toronto), "Vancouver, BC", or a housesigma.com city link. One of city, municipality_id or bounds is required.

parameters.name: municipality_id
parameters.description: HouseSigma municipality id (from /housesigma/v1/cities) instead of city.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Map area instead of a city: lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2 (two opposite corners).

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Province of the city (default ON; a "City, BC" input or a city link sets it).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: for_sale (default) or for_lease.

parameters.name: house_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated property types: detached, semi_detached, freehold_townhouse, condo_townhouse, condo_apt, link, multiplex, vacant_land, other.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price (CAD; monthly rent for leases).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price (CAD; monthly rent for leases).

parameters.name: bedrooms
parameters.description: Comma-separated bedroom counts: studio, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (5 = 5+).

parameters.name: baths_min
parameters.description: Minimum bathrooms (0-5).

parameters.name: garage_min
parameters.description: Minimum garage spaces (0-5).

parameters.name: sqft_min
parameters.description: Minimum size in square feet.

parameters.name: sqft_max
parameters.description: Maximum size in square feet (4000 = no limit).

parameters.name: lot_front_min
parameters.description: Minimum lot frontage in feet.

parameters.name: lot_front_max
parameters.description: Maximum lot frontage in feet (100 = no limit).

parameters.name: basement
parameters.description: Comma-separated: finished, separate, walkout.

parameters.name: open_house
parameters.description: Only listings with an open house: today, tomorrow, 7days or any.

parameters.name: listed_within_days
parameters.description: Listed in the last 1, 3, 7, 30 or 90 days (or -15, -30, -60, -90: listed more than that many days ago).

parameters.name: max_maintenance_fee
parameters.description: Maximum monthly condo fee.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Words in the listing description.

parameters.name: listing_type
parameters.description: all (default), resale, or assignment (leaves assignment sales out).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 per page, up to 200).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
HouseSigma's search box: matching listings (address, MLS number) and places (cities, communities, streets) with ids and coordinates for a text such as a street address or MLS number.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/housesigma-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Address, street, MLS number, community or city (2+ characters).

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Province to search first (default ON).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
